title: Journal is canonical.
current_guarantee: Every run-state transition is appended and fsynced to a hash-chained EventEnvelope v2 stream before its replaceable JSON projection is written.

title: A snapshot is a deterministic projection of the journal.
current_guarantee: Run JSON snapshots are deterministic, replaceable projections that rebuild bit-for-bit from the canonical stream and are verified against stream and checkpoint hashes.

title: Every command is idempotent.
current_guarantee: Mutating HTTP and supported CLI control requests enter one durable Command Bus. An exact duplicate returns its stored result without re-executing the handler; a reused key with different input fails closed, stale expected stream versions conflict, and interrupted outcomes are never guessed or retried automatically.

title: Every external side effect has durable intent before execution.
current_guarantee: 0.8 records some operator intent before side effects, such as integration dispositions before an integration task is queued. The durable outbox for all external writes is planned and is not a current guarantee.

title: Every external side effect is reconcilable.
current_guarantee: 0.8 reconciles selected effects, such as draft PR CI status polling, but does not maintain a universal action ledger with unknown-effect reconciliation for every external write.

title: At most one valid worker lease exists for a node.
current_guarantee: 0.8 has a single-server state-directory lease and scheduler claim limits, but not the planned per-node WorkerLease with lease IDs and fencing epochs.

title: An old worker cannot commit after lease takeover.
current_guarantee: Planned for the 0.9 kernel. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; current workers do not carry fenced lease epochs on every mutation.

title: Accepted is not Published.
current_guarantee: Accepting a reviewed run records a local artifact and leaves delivery as not_applied. Applying locally or creating a draft PR is a separate explicit action.

title: Published is not Integrated.
current_guarantee: 0.8 keeps draft PR delivery statuses distinct from integrated delivery statuses, but there is no full publication and integration object model yet.

title: Integrated is not Deployed.
current_guarantee: Planned for a deployment-capable release after the 0.9 kernel. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; 0.8 does not model deployment as a first-class state transition.

title: Deployed is not Healthy.
current_guarantee: Planned for a deployment-observation release after the 0.9 kernel. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; 0.8 does not model health observation windows as first-class outcome evidence.

title: A validator validates an immutable artifact SHA.
current_guarantee: Planned for the 0.9 kernel. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; current proof requires ordered verifier evidence before artifact acceptance, but validators do not yet receive immutable artifact SHAs through a read-only validation object.

title: A validator cannot mutate the candidate it validates.
current_guarantee: Planned for the 0.9 kernel. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; current validation is not isolated through immutable artifact inputs and read-only candidate mounts.

title: A router recommendation is not a routing decision.
current_guarantee: The outcome router can produce a recommendation while leaving the applied lane at the operator default. Automatic routing records when the recommendation is actually applied.

title: Missing evidence is not successful evidence.
current_guarantee: Production proof excludes queued or manually edited terminal records that lack ordered agent, verifier, artifact, and terminal evidence. A failed final verifier makes the attempted acceptance ineligible.

title: A missing metric is not zero.
current_guarantee: Missing cost telemetry remains None or Unknown in proof and portfolio calculations instead of being counted as zero cost.

title: A child policy can restrict but never widen a parent policy.
current_guarantee: Planned for the 0.9 policy model. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; 0.8 does not implement hierarchical policy composition with parent-child widening checks.

title: Every final outcome has lineage to a requirement and artifact.
current_guarantee: 0.8 records provenance, context receipts, source documents, artifact SHAs, and proof receipts for observed runs. It does not yet have immutable ChangeContractVersion and OutcomeRecord lineage for every final outcome.

title: Every autonomous decision is explainable from stored evidence.
current_guarantee: Outcome routing stores recommendation evidence, counterfactuals, fallback reasons, and applied-lane reasons. A universal explanation envelope for every autonomous decision is planned.

title: State can be reconstructed after arbitrary process death.
current_guarantee: 0.9 reconstructs run projections and missing operator activity records after a process dies following canonical fsync. Other state stores and external side effects remain outside this guarantee until the idempotent command and outbox releases.

title: Artifact bytes always match their immutable content hash.
current_guarantee: Planned for the 0.9 content-addressed ArtifactStore. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; current accepted artifacts are Git commits identified by artifact_sha, not immutable CAS objects with byte verification on every read.

title: Approval applies to exactly one artifact, evidence, and contract tuple.
current_guarantee: Planned for the 0.9 ReviewDecision model. Not a current 0.8 guarantee; 0.8 approval records an accepted artifact, but does not bind a formal artifact_sha, evidence_bundle_hash, contract_version, and plan_version tuple.

title: Secrets never cross the durable persistence boundary unredacted.
current_guarantee: 0.8 redacts selected external issue evidence and assistant shared context, and tolerates redacted vendor usage. A complete redaction engine before every durable and browser-stream boundary is planned.

title: Historical domain-event bytes are never rewritten during schema evolution.
current_guarantee: Historical canonical event envelopes remain byte-identical while older schemas are upcast into the current representation at read time.

title: Duplicate inbound or outbound messages cannot cause duplicate logical effects.
current_guarantee: 0.8 deduplicates selected inbound observations and attention items, and avoids duplicate delivery actions for integrated statuses. Universal inbound and outbound message idempotency is planned.
